shortfall_reason: 12/20 distinct supported concepts; shortfall 8. Five primary content pages were read, including original Zenodo metadata API rather than its browser challenge. Two records enrich matching existing voice IDs; ten are separate metadata concepts. NCVS returned HTTP 403 and is excluded. Wider readable ASHA and Shure primary guidance supplements VCTK. Existing gendered warm/husky/narration directions and further phonation types were not established from readable evidence; no padding with uninspected audio or generic aliases. All 38 facts are source_claim, with no observations, measurements, creative proposals or media candidates. No audio/image/video acquisition, independent review or DB application. Public reading does not grant media rights.
